newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Investment Bank in $26mln MCPC financing.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Investment Bank in $26mln MCPC financing.

text.p: The Saudi Investment Bank said it had signed a 97 million riyal ($26 million) credit facility with Medical and Cosmetic Products Co (MCPC), which is building a 200 million riyal pharmaceutical plant in the capital Riyadh.

The bank said the agreement was signed by its general manager Saud al-Saleh, al-Haya Medical Co managing director Walid Amin Kayyali, and Talal Omar Aggad of Aggad Investment Co. The two firms are the major shareholders in the new company.
The SAIB statement said the factory would produce a wide range of pharmaceutical products under licence from international manufacturers, as well as a range of cosmetics.

Saudi Arabia is one of the Middle East's largest consumers of pharmaceutical products with the market valued at more than three billion riyals a year, of which local production accounts for less than 15 percent.
